notes: No accepted Reptilia taxon exists in the GBIF backbone (Reptilia is a pro-parte synonym split among Crocodylia, Squamata, Sphenodontia and Testudines), so gbif_usage_key is null and no GBIF occurrence count was built. NCBI Taxonomy has no Reptilia node (reptiles sit under Sauropsida, taxid 8457, which also includes birds), so ncbi_taxid is null.
